summary: Massive Russian precision strikes hit Kiev, Zaporozhye, and Odessa infrastructure overnight. Ukraine responded with drone attacks on Russian oil refinery and airfield in Yaroslavl and Rostov-on-Don. Multiple Shahed, Geran-5, Banderol, and FPV drone attacks tracked across northern, central, and southern Ukraine.
key_points: Overnight massive strikes on Kiev, Zaporozhye, Odessa infrastructure: metallurgical, radio-electronic, military-industrial, energy, transport (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33315)
Ukraine drones hit Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl and Rostov-on-Don Centralny airfield, causing large fires (Source: @UkraineNow/84136)
FPV drone attacked passenger bus in Zaporizhzhia, 5 civilians wounded (Source: @eRadarrua/114051)
Night of Sept 17: hits on 36 locations, 5 debris; Kiev 16 wounded (2 children 10, 12), Odesa 6 (2 children), Zaporizhzhia 3 (Source: @UkraineNow/84135)
Banderol loitering munitions tracked from Chernihiv through Kyiv reservoir westward, past Nizhyn toward Kyivshchyna (Source: @kpszsu/78693)
8 Banderol mCR past Nizhyn toward Kyivshchyna; 2 Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Vyshgorod district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75047, /75033)
Reactive UAVs from Donetsk north to Dnipropetrovsk; 1 from Zaporizhzhia toward Tomakivka (Source: @eRadarrua/114055)
Body exchange at Novaya Guta: Russia 252, Ukraine 23 fallen servicemen (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33331)

sections.executive_summary: Massive Russian precision strikes hit Kiev, Zaporozhye, and Odessa infrastructure overnight targeting metallurgical, radio-electronic, military-industrial, energy, and transport facilities. Ukraine responded with drone attacks on Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl and Rostov-on-Don Centralny airfield. Multiple Shahed, Geran-5, Banderol, FPV, and reactive UAV attacks tracked across northern, central, and southern Ukraine simultaneously.
ukraine: Kiev struck: 16 wounded including children aged 10 and 12; Elena Zelenska Foundation warehouse destroyed by drone strike; Kvartal 95 props warehouse also destroyed (Source: @UkraineNow/84135, @ukr_leaks_eng/33318).
Kievshchyna under multiple attacks: 2 Banderols to Zghurivka, 2 to Myronivka/Boguslav, 1 to Dymyr; 7 Banderols to Chornobyl zone past Oster/Desna toward Kaharlyk (Source: @eRadarrua/114023, /114065).
Shahed attacks on Kyiv area: 2 from south to Vasylkiv; 3 more to Irpin and Bucha; air alert possible within 15-25 minutes warning (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75037, /75040, /75032).
Shahed on Kropyvnytskyi outskirts detected twice; 1 Ukrainian interceptor shot down enemy UAV with new interceptor system confirmed by Zelensky (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75012, /75011, @UkraineNow/84147).
russia: Ukrainian drones attacked Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl — largest oil refinery in northern Russia — causing massive fire (Source: @UkraineNow/84136).
Military airfield Rostov-on-Don Centralny attacked, massive fire in city (Source: @UkraineNow/84136).
Russia reports liberation of Rozovka settlement in Zaporozhye region and Malaya Volchya village in Kharkiv region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33325).
Alabuga SEZ expanding Geran-4/5 production: at least 5 new long production halls, roads cut, more buildings under construction; Iran requested Gerans from Russia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33332).

New Russian medical reform: CT coronary calcium screening for SCORE-risk citizens, abdominal aorta ultrasound for smokers 65-75, expanded CT indications for 20+ pack-year smokers (Source: @tass_agency/395862).
eastern_front: Zaporizhzhia: FPV drone attacked passenger bus, 5 civilians wounded; Russia claims Rozovka liberated (Source: @eRadarrua/114051, @ukr_leaks_eng/33325).
Reactive UAVs from Donetsk direction northward to Dnipropetrovsk; 1 UAV from Zaporizhzhia toward Tomakivka (Source: @eRadarrua/114055).
Reactive UAV from Zaporizhzhia direction toward Tomakivka in Dnipropetrovsk region tracked (Source: @eRadarrua/114055).
Election commission chair in Zaporozhye region killed by UAV strike; criminal case opened for terrorism (Source: @tass_agency/395855).
northern_front: Chernihivshchyna: 8 Banderol mCR past Nizhyn toward Kyivshchyna; Banderol near Bahmach heading to Kyivshchyna; reactive to Nizhyn, Banderol to Konotop (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75047, @kpszsu/78692, @eRadarrua/114058).
2 Geran-5 missiles from Chernihivshchyna to Kyivshchyna, Vyshgorod district; Banderol from Chernihiv through Kyiv reservoir westward (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75033, @kpszsu/78693).
New Shaheds from Bryansk shchyna to Chernihivshchyna, Chernihiv district detected (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75031).
Sumy shchyna: strike UAV 3 groups active; Poltava: reactive toward Romodan (Source: @eRadarrua/114073).
southern_front: Odesa: 6 wounded including 2 children; reactive UAV past Krasnosilka heading to Odesa from Odesa region (Source: @UkraineNow/84135, @kpszsu/78684).
Zaporizhzhia: 3 wounded; under massive overnight strikes on infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/84135, @ukr_leaks_eng/33315).
Reactive UAV from Poltava to Cherkasy toward Kremenchuk reservoir tracked (Source: @kpszsu/78690).
Dnipropetrovsk: group of reactive UAVs through Yuriivka northwest course; reactive UAV heading to Kamianske (Source: @kpszsu/78673, /78668).
air_war: Shahed attacks: from Brovary left bank of capital; 2 from south to Kyiv Vasylkiv; from Bryansk to Chernihiv; Kropyvnytskyi outskirts; Irpin/Bucha — 3 more (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75038, /75037, /75031, /75012, /75040).

Banderol loitering munitions: 8 past Nizhyn; near Bahmach; from Chernihiv through Kyiv reservoir westward; to Konotop; 7 to Chornobyl zone past Oster/Desna (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75047, @kpszsu/78692, /78693, @eRadarrua/114058, /114065).

Reactive UAVs: Dnipropetrovsk group through Yuriivka northwest; to Kamianske; Poltava to Cherkasy toward Kremenchuk; Donetsk north to Dnipropetrovsk; Zaporizhzhia to Tomakivka; Odesa past Krasnosilka (Source: @kpszsu/78673, /78668, /78690, @eRadarrua/114055, /78684).
Ukraine shot down enemy UAV with new interceptor; Zelensky confirms positive test results vs reactive Shaheds, new active long-range operations preparing (Source: @UkraineNow/84147).
key_developments: Massive Russian precision strikes on Kiev, Zaporozhye, Odessa infrastructure: metallurgical, radio-electronic, military-industrial, energy, transport facilities hit overnight (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33315).
Ukrainian drones strike Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl (largest northern Russia oil refinery) and Rostov-on-Don Centralny airfield, both with massive fires (Source: @UkraineNow/84136).
FPV drone attack on passenger bus in Zaporizhzhia wounds 5 civilians; election commission chair killed by UAV in Zaporozhye region (Source: @eRadarrua/114051, @tass_agency/395855).
8 Banderol mCR past Nizhyn toward Kyivshchyna; 2 Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Vyshgorod district; 7 Banderols to Chornobyl zone past Oster/Desna (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75047, /75033, @eRadarrua/114065).
Night Sept 17: 36 locations hit, 5 debris; Kiev 16 wounded (2 children 10, 12), Odesa 6 (2 children), Zaporizhzhia 3; Zelenska Foundation warehouse destroyed (Source: @UkraineNow/84135, /33318).
Body exchange at Novaya Guta crossing: Russia returns 252, Ukraine 23; humanitarian corridor: 15 Russians to Ukraine, 3 Ukrainians to Russia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33331, @tass_agency/395852).
US Congress passes Graham sanctions bill 269-159: up to 100% tariffs on countries buying Russian oil/gas, expanded energy/defense/shadow fleet sanctions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33313).
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting multi-axis aerial offensives simultaneously against Kiev, central, southern, and northern Ukraine using Shahed, Geran-5, Banderol, reactive UAVs, and FPV drones, indicating sustained high-tempo operations. Ukraine's new interceptor system shows promise against Shaheds but volume of attacks overwhelms defenses. Russian production expansion at Alabuga SEZ with 5 new halls signals growing Geran-4/5 capacity. The combination of infrastructure strikes and border-area attacks suggests Russia aims to degrade Ukrainian military-industrial capacity and morale while testing Polish border security enhancements.
sections.regional_response: Poland is installing electronic monitoring and motion sensors along its border with Ukraine's Volyn and Lviv regions, signaling heightened concern over cross-border threats. US Congress passed Graham sanctions bill targeting Russian oil buyers, energy, defense sectors, and shadow fleet, now awaiting Trump signature. Russia and Ukraine continue body exchanges at Novaya Guta crossing. Ternopil medical commission scandal reveals systematic evasion of mobilization through forged medical certificates.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple UAV types (Shahed, Geran-4/5, Banderol, FPV, reactive) employed simultaneously across all fronts, suggesting Russian forces are testing Ukrainian air defense coverage gaps. The concentration of Banderol movements through Chernihiv toward Kyiv and westward through Kyiv reservoir indicates deliberate attempts to bypass eastern defenses. Satellite imagery of Alabuga expansion confirms Iran-Russia drone production cooperation extending to new export markets. The absence of US from Norwegian king funeral and parallel Ukraine peace talks discussions signal potential shifting US diplomatic posture ahead of negotiations.
